layout_strategies.main_container: max-w-md mx-auto h-screen flex flex-col bg-background shadow-2xl overflow-hidden relative border-x border-border
layout_strategies.input_area: p-4 bg-background/80 backdrop-blur-lg border-t border-border z-20 absolute bottom-0 w-full
layout_strategies.dashboard_drawer: fixed inset-y-0 right-0 z-50 w-3/4 max-w-sm bg-background border-l shadow-2xl transform transition-transform duration-300 ease-in-out

buttons.primary: bg-primary hover:bg-primary/90 text-white rounded-full font-bold px-6 py-3 shadow-lg hover:shadow-xl transition-all active:scale-95
buttons.ghost: hover:bg-accent hover:text-accent-foreground rounded-full px-4 py-2 text-sm font-medium transition-colors

chat_bubbles.ai: bg-white dark:bg-card border border-border rounded-2xl rounded-tl-none p-4 shadow-sm text-foreground max-w-[85%]
chat_bubbles.user: bg-primary text-primary-foreground rounded-2xl rounded-tr-none p-4 shadow-md max-w-[85%] ml-auto

cards.base: bg-card border border-border rounded-xl shadow-sm hover:shadow-md transition-shadow duration-200
cards.metric: p-4 flex flex-col justify-between h-32 relative overflow-hidden

inputs.chat: w-full bg-muted border-0 focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-primary/50 rounded-full px-6 py-4 pr-12 shadow-inner text-base

visual_enhancers.gradients: Use subtle radial gradients behind main actions. No full-screen gradients.

3d_hydration.description: A 3D water bottle that fills up as user logs water.
3d_hydration.implementation_note: Use a simple cylinder geometry if model loading fails. Make it spin slowly on hover.

universal_guidelines: Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur)
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, parallax effects, and entrance animations.
Components MUST use named exports (export const ComponentName = ...)
Pages MUST use default exports (export default function PageName() {...})
Do not use transparent backgrounds for dropdowns/headers without a blur or solid color backing.
All interactive elements MUST have data-testid attributes.
instructions_to_main_agent: PHASE 1: Setup Tailwind config with the 'colors' and 'typography' defined above.
PHASE 2: Install required libraries: framer-motion, lucide-react, @react-three/fiber, @react-three/drei, canvas-confetti, clsx, tailwind-merge.
PHASE 3: Build the 'ChatInterface' as the main layout. It should feel like a premium mobile app.
PHASE 4: Implement the 'DashboardDrawer' using the Sheet/Drawer Shadcn component but customized.
PHASE 5: Add the 3D Water Bottle widget in the Dashboard.
CRITICAL: The Chat is the SOURCE of TRUTH. All logging happens via natural language or Quick Actions in the chat.
